pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: move a thread by copying it
experience: Asked to move a started thread into the right project, an agent had no move action, so it could only fork the thread or start a new one, which leaves the conversation behind (batchema/t3code#6).
rule: t3_thread_organize move: the thread keeps its history and continues in the target project's root.

t3_thread_organize.notice: The conversation moves with it, and the agent works in api's folder from the next message. Earlier diffs open while their original folder exists.

prompt: I started thread thread-auth-retry in the web project by mistake; the bug is in api. Move that thread over to the api project so it keeps going there.
